Resolves #21306

`/examples` is now a page in the group page's shell: the banded index upright at the left with "All examples" current, and at the right every example the selected build publishes, once, in catalog order, so the page opens on the showcases. It is one more `GroupPage` (`family: null`), not a new class. The overview and what only it consumed are gone: `Overview.mjs`, `GroupList.mjs`, their stylesheets, the `overview` presentation of `GroupIndex`, `tile` in the group definitions, and `image` and `tile` of `ExampleGroup`. 264 lines in, 679 out.

Evidence: L3 (the page rendered in headless Chromium on the dev server: the e2e spec and the frames below) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5 and AC-8 are about the rendered page). Residual: none.

Prescription checked: `apps/portal/view/examples/GroupPage.mjs` owns the shell, and `MainContainer.mjs` owns which page is the first card; no other layer decides what `/examples` renders. Maryam's peer read named the same mechanism, and the flat list, before the ticket was filed. She reviews this pull request, so the independent read of that choice is the cold look below.

## Deltas from ticket
- `GroupIndex` loses its per-band class (`portal-examples-group-index-band-<band>`): only the overview's stylesheet read it.
- The e2e helper `openGroup` goes through the index beside the cards, or below 640 px through the sheet, because no overview stands between two groups any more.
- The theme tests now measure every published card on the page of all examples (cover, caption fit, closed action line), where they measured the eight group tiles of the first band. All 43 pass in both themes.
- Out of scope, noted in defect-note `12a024c7`: where the Portal runs the build it shows, it hides its own card, so a heading names one example more than its page shows. The Apps group does that on `dev` today.

## Cold look
Two readers without session context, each a fresh model session given only the first screen and the whole page of both versions at 1440 px, unlabelled and in swapped order, were asked how much each page makes them want to open an example (1 to 10).

| Reader | As released | As changed | Preferred, and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1: a frontend engineer evaluating UI frameworks; released shown first | 7 | 8 | changed: "every card is an example", where the released page "adds a navigation layer before anything runs" |
| 2: no persona; changed shown first | 6 | 8 | changed: it "puts real, enticing examples in front of me immediately, so one click opens one" |

Both readers saw the released page's blue "Open the 100,000 × 200 grid" button first, and both miss a starting point on the new page. What they would change there, and where each point lives:
- "No hierarchy: 43 equal cards in arbitrary order" (reader 1); "a flat wall of 43 with no 'start here'; a hero button like B's would help" (reader 2). The page reads the catalog top to bottom, so the catalog's order is now the page's order (the slate, #21142), and a starting point is the page header's question (#21131, where both quotes now stand).
- Raw class names as titles beside product names ("component.Helix", "form.field.ComboBox"), and dark look-alike covers: each record's name and cover (#21142, #21146).
- "Running the production build" reads "like a status, not a control"; a count in parentheses and the window icon on some cards are unexplained: #21131.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After the Engine 14 deploy, `/examples` on neomjs.com shows the group list beside every published example, and `/examples/unknown` lands there.

### `@neo-fable-mnemosyne` commented on 2026-11-18T06:48:34Z

**Author note on the review of 06:43Z (Approved, no required actions), head `e9d8a6a3bc`.** Two points from its Depth Floor, with where each stands:

- **No page until `examples.json` has loaded, and none if the fetch fails.** The pages are built from the store in `publishGroups()`, so the container is empty until `load`. I have not run the failed-fetch case; the reading is the reviewer's and I take it as stated. Not changed here: a fallback for a failed catalog load is a decision about what the section shows without data, and it belongs with the open question on the page of all examples (`#21131`).
- **Overlap with `#21301`.** It meets this change in two places: `board.tile` in `MainContainer.mjs` and the overview assertions in both specs. Whichever merges second rebases; this change removes `tile` and the overview, so after it `#21301` keeps its covers and drops those two.
